verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned toward me and heard my cry.
He pulled me out of a dreadful pit, out of the sticky mud. He set my feet on a rock and gave me firm footing.
He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many will see what he’s done, stand in awe, and trust the LORD.
Blessed are those who put their trust in the LORD and turn away from the proud and from people who chase lies.
LORD my God, you’ve done so many wonders and made so many plans for us. If I tried to tell you about them all, they’d be more than I could count.
You didn’t want sacrifice or offering. You opened my ears. You didn’t require a burnt offering or a sin offering.
Then I said, “Here I am. What is written about me is in the scroll.
I take joy in doing your will, my God. Your instruction is in my heart.”
I’ve announced the good news of your righteousness in the great assembly. You know, LORD, that I won’t keep quiet.
I haven’t kept your righteousness to myself. I’ve told of your faithfulness and your salvation. I haven’t hidden your faithful love or your truth from the great assembly.
LORD, don’t hold back your tender mercy from me. Keep me safe always with your faithful love and truth.
Troubles beyond counting surround me. My wrongs have caught up with me, and I can’t lift my eyes. They outnumber the hairs on my head, and my courage is gone.
Please rescue me, LORD. Hurry to help me, LORD.
Let those who want to take my life be put to shame and confusion together. Turn back and disgrace those who enjoy seeing me hurt.
Let their own shame leave them devastated when they say to me, “Aha! Aha!”
Let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation keep saying, “How great is the LORD!”
I’m poor and needy. Lord, remember me. You’re my help and my rescuer. My God, don’t delay.
